author: goblirsc
body:
#### PR description:
This PR updates the Cosmic Track Finder chain to work with the Phase 2 CMS detector.

This is done by 
- replacing the (Phase-2 incompatible) original seeder by the Phase-2 grid seeder when running on Phase-2
- updating the trajectory candidate builder to consume Phase-1 and / or Phase-2 hits, using slots for all possible collections of which some will be empty for each scenario 
- updating the internal hit sorting / seed hit removal logic to work with fewer assumptions on the internal ordering of the seeds than the Phase-1 setup 
- updating the configuration to re-enable the cosmic track finder chain for Phase-2. 

The changes were discussed and validation plots studied in [the 28.10. TrkPOG/DPG meeting](https://indico.cern.ch/event/1724617/#20-cosmic-track-finder-results) 

This a step towards resolving [#52257](https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/issues/52257), the resurrection of ALCARECO for Phase-2. 

#### PR validation:

Unit tests and RunTheMatrix workflows 7,7.1,7.20,7.21,7.22,7.23,7.24,7.25,7.3,7.4,7.5,8,8.1,8.2 succeed. 

#### If this PR is a backport please specify the original PR and why you need to backport that PR. If this PR will be backported please specify to which release cycle the backport is meant for:

Not intended to be backported, only relevant for Phase-2.
title: Update Cosmic Track Finder for Phase-2 tracker
